items.source: This is particularly useful for issuing multiple calls on the same connection.
items.translation: 这对于在同一连接上发出多个调用特别有用。

items.source:
Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain
objects.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即一个领域对象或一组领域对象。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveRedisOperations.executeInSession(ReactiveRedisSessionCallback) with an active Redis connection.
items.translation: 由ReactiveRedisOperations.executeInSession(ReactiveRedisSessionCallback)调用，此时已拥有活跃的 Redis 连接。

items.source: a result object Publisher.
items.translation: 一个结果对象 Publisher。

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions.
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况。

items.source: Generic callback interface for code that wants to use the same ReactiveRedisConnection avoiding connection allocation overhead upon each Template API method call. Allows to execute any number of operations on a single ReactiveRedisConnection, using any type and number of commands.
items.translation: 用于希望使用相同的 ReactiveRedisConnection 的代码的通用回调接口，可避免在每次调用模板 API 方法时产生连接分配开销。允许在单个 ReactiveRedisConnection 上执行任意数量的操作，支持任何类型和数量的命令。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveRedisOperations.executeInSession(ReactiveRedisSessionCallback) with an active Redis connection. Does not need to care about activating or closing the ReactiveRedisConnection.
items.translation: 由ReactiveRedisOperations.executeInSession(ReactiveRedisSessionCallback)调用，此时已拥有活跃的 Redis 连接。无需关心激活或关闭ReactiveRedisConnection。
